entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Ah, [lName]-senpai.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: What a pleasant surprise.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's really pouring down, isn't it?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I thought something like this would[n]happen...
entries.uk: Я так і думав, що щось таке[n]станеться...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So I snuck a collapsible umbrella into[n]your bag!
entries.uk: Тому нишком поклав тобі в сумку[n]складану парасольку!

entries.en: Thanks a bunch.
Keep packing for me, please.
What a considerate kitty.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, you do carry me around in your[n]bag all the time. I've gotta show my[n]appreciation somehow!
entries.uk: Ну, ти ж постійно носиш мене[n]в сумці. Мушу якось віддячити!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Want me to pack a towel and change[n]of underwear next time?
entries.uk: Покласти наступного разу рушник[n]і змінну білизну?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Of course—this isn't something any[n]ordinary cat would do.
entries.uk: Авжеж — звичайний кіт такого[n]не зробив би.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And just in case you've forgotten[n]again, I'm a human, not a cat!
entries.uk: І якщо ти раптом знову забув:[n]я людина, а не кіт!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Well, see you around.
Won't you get wet, though?
Where's your umbrella?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Actually, I forgot my umbrella...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Unfortunately, I forgot it...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But it's fine. I'll barely get wet if I run[n]to the station!
entries.uk: Але нічого. Якщо добігти до станції,[n]я майже не змокну!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: If anything, it'll make for good training.
You want a piece of this?
Care to walk together?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, you'll share your umbrella?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Huh? But how are... Oh, are you[n]offering to share your umbrella?
entries.uk: Га? Але як... О, ви пропонуєте[n]поділитися парасолькою?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: That'd be wonderful! Thank you[n]so much!
